quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: firm-fixed-price, sole-source IDIQ contract M67854-26-D-5110 to Keysight Technologies Inc. (Colorado Springs, Colorado) for Microwave Radio Test Sets (MRTS) — calibration, repair and other operations and maintenance support for the existing MRTS inventory and procurement of new MRTS units; ordering period up to four years, expected completion September 2030; contracting activity Marine Corps Systems Command, Quantico, Virginia.
